name: Naveena N
objective: AI/ML Engineer with experience building end-to-end ML pipelines, LLM-powered RAG applications, and multi-agent systems in Python. Focused on shipping production-ready AI with MLOps best practices, from document intelligence to agentic workflows.

highlights: Developed GnA Intelligence Engine, an agentic AI finance and analytics platform using ReAct and LlamaIndex for autonomous reasoning and tool orchestration; deployed on AWS EC2 via FastAPI.

Built a live AI avatar with Google Cloud Vertex AI for a logistics application, acting as an interactive product guide that demos the full application and answers questions on any of its features in real time.

Built ML-powered document intelligence pipelines for document classification and structured information extraction, integrating FastAPI with Snowflake; optimized model accuracy and inference latency through iterative hyperparameter tuning.
Contributed to internal CI/CD workflows and MLflow-based experiment tracking, leveraging AWS S3 presigned URLs for secure artifact storage and ensuring reproducible ML deployments.
Authored an internal research white paper on VoxAPI, a secure gateway over third-party LLM providers, benchmarking the impact of hyperparameters on output quality using BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore.
Built multimodal CV workflows for document analysis across text, tables, and images, reducing manual effort by around 95%.

Built a NumPy/Pandas data pipeline for ingestion, cleaning, and transformation of enterprise datasets, and engineered a multi-agent AI system with AutoGen and ChromaDB that auto-summarizes data into structured insights, reducing manual effort by 40%.

projects.name: FinSight AI - Agentic Financial Budget Analyst
highlights: Architected a multi-agent RAG workflow in LangGraph that plans queries, routes between SQL lookups and pgvector similarity search, and verifies numeric answers against ground-truth tables to curb hallucinations.
Built a PyMuPDF ETL pipeline that turned a 121-page government fiscal white paper into 223 section-aware chunks and 42 relational tables in Neon PostgreSQL.

Shipped an MCP server (4 tools) for Claude Desktop/Cursor, a dual-LLM failover layer (Gemini -> GPT-4o-mini), and a Next.js 14 dashboard on Vercel; scored 95.6% precision on an automated eval suite of 30 benchmark test cases.

projects.name: Customer Churn Prediction with MLOps
highlights: Built a production-ready ML pipeline for telecom churn prediction on 7,000+ real-world records - covering automated preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and batch inference.
Evaluated multiple classifiers; Logistic Regression achieved ROC AUC 0.845 and F1 0.61, demonstrating principled model selection with proper metric-driven comparison.
Implemented MLflow for experiment tracking and model versioning to ensure reproducibility, and designed a modular, container-ready architecture for deployment using Docker and FastAPI.
